Blue Ridge: The Series
programme.desc: A murder at the local theater turns an unorthodox production of Romeo and Juliet into a fatally unscripted crime drama. Sheriff Justin and his daughter Maddie work in tandem to discover the killer before the curtain falls on another victim.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben hires Sam Jackson to help on a cattle drive. Jackson is really Outlaw Johnny Logan. Johnny signed for the drive since it was going near the town of Waycross, where he plans to kill the Waycross sheriff, who is his father.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Wild Bill Hickok and his buddy, Davis Tutt, see their friendship fall apart over gambling debts and the affections of a beautiful woman. After Tutt swipes Wild Bill's prized timepiece as payback for a disputed debt, things begin to heat up. Then, when Tutt parades through town with the watch in one hand and Hickok's former girlfriend in the other, Wild Bill's blood begins to boil. Tutt refuses to return the watch, and he continues to flaunt the beautiful woman on his arm. The two men meet in the middle of town to settle their differences once and for all in what will become the very first quick-draw duel of the Old West. Both men reach for their pistols at the same time and fire! In an attempt to separate the truth from the fiction, Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, interviews George Ward Nichols, the journalist who immortalized the duel and created the legend of Wild Bill Hickok.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Freshly-graduated from medical school, Dr. Susan Anderson sets up a practice in Cripple Creek, Colorado, a rough-and-tumble mining town. At a time when only ten percent of physicians are female, Dr. Anderson faces her share of doubters and has a difficult time attracting patients in the frontier town. When miners suddenly rush into her office with an injured boy, she defies prevailing wisdom and decides to save his mangled arm instead of amputating the limb. The risks are enormous. If the boy's arm becomes infected, and he dies, she will lose everything. Years later, Dr. Anderson relives the story while treating Bat Masterson, legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman, who comes down with fever while passing through Cripple Creek.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: In his quest to become king of the fur trade, William Sublette revolutionizes the industry and puts his life on the line in the process. But he may risk too much when he rushes to save his comrades in the largest battle of the mountain man era.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: Half of the 14 all-star cowboys have been eliminated. The remaining seven contestants must demonstrate skill and grit in a grueling relay race made up of a series of cowboy challenges. Host Trace Adkins and his expert judges send another cowboy home.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: The remaining 6 cowboys face off in a cutting competition that turns out to be more difficult than expected. Then, they work as a team to sort 4 rogue cattle from a herd and load them on a trailer. Host Trace Adkins and the judges send a cowboy home.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. First, she travels to a remote area of Alaska to meet husband-and-wife Master Bladesmiths Adam and Haley DesRosiers, who make some of the world's most sought after knives. Then, she heads to Hickory, North Carolina, to meet Master Woodworker Eddie Hamrick, a world-renowned craftsman who can make just about anything out of wood. Finally, Jill is off to Austin, Texas, to meet Cambria Harkey, a leatherworker whose beautiful handbags are appreciated by everyday folks and red-carpet celebrities.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: Taylor journeys to Delaware, The First State, to get a first-rate meal filled with local flavors and homegrown history! Taylor finds that the smallest state grows some really big fruit and hops aboard a watermelon transplanter to plant and finally eat this sweet seedless treat. Then, he herds the state's number one export, poultry, and discovers the tasty entree of chicken and slippery dumplings. Historic Rehoboth Beach is home to world famous twice-cooked boardwalk fries, this time served Taylor made salt-and-vinegar style. Taylor samples unique breeds of genetically grown lima beans at the University of Delaware. Finally, he finds a gooey dish of goodness made from the fruit of the state flower, the peach blossom, and indulges in a delicious dessert of peach crumble pie.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben, Hoss and Joe decide to visit San Francisco with some of their ranch hands. The hands vanish into the crowds and while searching for them, Ben finds himself shanghaied and on a ship destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When an elusive bandito terrorizes early Los Angeles County, an eager reporter shadows the sheriff who is hunting the dangerous outlaw. Will the reporter stay objective or take matters into his own hands when he comes face to face with the killer?

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When Bronco Bill and his gang are robbing trains at will, two veteran lawmen join forces to stop the violent outlaws once and for all. Years later, gunfighter-turned-reporter Bat Masterson hears the story from the last surviving member of the gang.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Though Andrew Henry has little experience when he partners in a trapping expedition, he pledges his word to complete the risky venture. As Blackfeet warriors close in, he must weigh his personal integrity against the lives of the men he leads.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Cody and Booger close their biggest cattle deal ever on The Cowboy Way! The million-dollar herd is ready to ship, but moving all that cattle into trucks becomes a race against the clock for their much-needed final paycheck. The cowboys help a woman remove cattle from her family's land when she is forced to sell the property after the passing of her parents. Having been through a similar situation, Booger is inspired to fix-up his family's old homestead as a special surprise for his grandma. Cody's book is finally finished, but as Misty plans the book-signing event, a missed shipment could derail the whole party. The Cattlemen's Association invites the guys to their annual ball, with a very special honor in store.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: After his fur trapping expedition is surprised by a Crow war party, legendary mountain man Jim Bridger suddenly finds himself in a desperate struggle to rescue his fellow trappers when one of them goes missing, and another is on the brink of madness.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
programme.desc: When bloodthirsty Canadian trappers try to kill him, mountain man Jim Bridger takes cover in an unexplored valley. There, he runs headlong into a family of escaped slaves who show him the huge footprints and fossilized bones of long-dead monsters.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: The five remaining cowboys get to show off their skills starting wild colts and taking them through an obstacle course. Then, they must rope and load as many steers as they can in 30 minutes. Host Trace Adkins and the judges eliminate two cowboys.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: In the final cattle drive of the season, the three remaining cowboys have one last chance to prove they deserve to be the Ultimate Cowboy All-Star Champion. Host Trace Adkins and the expert judges evaluate each cowboy's skills and determine a winner.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. Her first stop is Joliet, Illinois, where Chad and Jessica Schumacher of Allegory Pens are turning scraps of wood with historical significance into stunning writing instruments. Next, Jill meets up with former Oklahoma cowboy crooner, Michael Wayne Brooks, who moved to Los Angeles to make and sell his elaborate hand-stitched cowboy boots. Finally, it's off to Santa Fe, New Mexico, where Scott and Melissa Coleman of La Puerta Originals are creating new appreciation for long-forgotten doors.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: Host Taylor Hicks heads to a state known for mountains, mining and folk traditions, West Virginia. He tackles 350 pounds of dough to create a spicy, savory appetizer of pepperoni rolls. With more than 20,000 miles of streams, Taylor discovers an angler's paradise and falls hook-line-and-sinker for an entree of the West Virginia state fish, native brook trout. Next, he digs up wild onion-like ramps for a seasonal side dish sauteed in bacon grease. He churns butter by hand to create a real Southern staple, buttermilk biscuits. Finally, a true West Virginian mountain mama puts Taylor to work peeling native Golden Delicious apples for a caramel-drizzled apple dumpling dessert. It's time to build up an Appalachian appetite in this episode of State Plate!

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: When miner Lem Keith plans to buy land next to the Ponderosa, he goes to the owner's son, Todd, who is willing to help Lem because he is in love with Lem's daughter. Plus, they both share a common hatred of the Cartwrights.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After being sworn in as one of Oklahoma's first female deputy marshals, Ada Curnutt volunteers to track down two killers-turned-counterfeiters and concocts a cunning plan to bring them to justice without using a gun.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After a man murders his wife in a jealous rage and goes on the run, local lawmen are stunned when legendary Marshal Bass Reeves accepts responsibility for bringing the killer to justice...because the murderer is none other than Reeves' own son.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: While coming of age on America's frontier, Kit Carson sets a new standard for steely nerves and fearlessness. But his legend is born when a Native woman is insulted by a notorious bully of the mountains, and Kit challenges the man to a duel to death.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: It's a special Christmas Episode of The Cowboy Way. The holidays are always hectic, but for cowboys it's especially busy because it's also calving season. Time for the birth of new baby calves to join the herd. Bubba, Cody, and Booger must monitor their heifers around the clock and still find time to shop for gifts, decorate for Christmas, and enjoy time with their families. Booger helps Matthew pick out an extra-special gift to top Grandma's Christmas tree. Cody looks to buy Carter the perfect cute new puppy. Kaley enlists the wives to help prepare for the Thompson's annual holiday party. But, when a heifer who's in labor goes missing one night, the cowboys frantically search for her while trying to keep from missing the big event.

programme.title: County Line: No Fear
programme.desc: When Sheriff Alden Rockwell finally decides to retire, a threat against the father of his friend, Sheriff Jo Porter, may not only ruin his plans for a life of leisure but also bring a dangerous criminal syndicate to both Maksville and York counties.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Pretty Girls Kill
programme.desc: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty. 20 years later, now a detective, ghosts from her past resurface, and she must face these demons once again.

programme.title: Smoke Break
programme.desc: Trell Bell, a sharp-tongued barber balances cutting fades and dodging drama from his baby momma. When the barber shopped is suddenly robbed, and the money all gone, Trell and his crew work together to save the barber shop.

programme.title: Vegas Vixens
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, an escort’s murder ignites a fierce pursuit of justice. Her sister, undercover agent Sophia, teams up with disillusioned Detective Reddick to bring her killer to justice. As they delve deeper, a web of sex trafficking and drugs emerges, revealing hidden secrets and betrayals. Facing danger and corruption within the system, the women fight to dismantle a criminal empire and find closure in a city where justice seems elusive.

programme.title: Troubled Mystic
programme.desc: Tracie is a single mother who meets Corey Daniels, the calculated and “perfect guy” looking for his next perfect family to manipulate by any means necessary.

programme.title: But I'm Married
programme.desc: Kimora and Jamal, a successful power couple, face a dwindling passion in their marriage. Seeking to reignite their spark, Kimora explores unconventional options, including introducing a third person. This decision unleashes a whirlwind of hidden desires, lies, and betrayals. As secrets surface and trust erodes, Kimora must confront the consequences of her choices and rebuild her life, navigating the complexities of desire and the fragility of her marriage.

programme.title: The Perfect Challenge
programme.desc: Alfred & Della Hughes, a successful couple, face marital strife. Alfred's neglect and an affair strain their bond. Della, overwhelmed by household duties, feels undervalued. Their children witness their parents' escalating conflicts, leading to a tumultuous breakdown. Though their children plead for unity, divorce looms. A family intervention, sparked by a heartfelt gift, forces them to confront their deep-seated love and the possibility of reconciliation.

programme.title: Droppin Bodies
programme.desc: Julia, a mother haunted by a violent past, flees her old life to protect her daughter, Kelsey. But when Kelsey is tragically murdered by her boyfriend, Julia is left shattered and betrayed. Abandoned by a justice system that fails to bring her daughter's killer to account, she's forced to confront the darkness she once escaped.

programme.title: You Made Me This Way
programme.desc: Haunted by a failed assassination attempt, ruthless drug lord Kwame becomes obsessed with Aubrey, the woman who nearly ended his life. Consumed by revenge, he kidnaps her, setting in motion a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Housekeeper 2
programme.desc: After moving on from her sordid past, Sharease flourishes in her new life and success. When her son Adonis kidnapped, she seeks help from a ghost of her past to rescue him.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Sermon

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Discover Poland
programme.desc: The world‘s best helicopter camera system - the Cineflex Camera - was used for this documentary and delivered fantastic images in HD quality, revealing the surprisingly diverse landscapes and fascinating towns of Poland from a bird‘s eye view of Poland‘s medieval towns, the modern silhouette of Warsaw, the untouched nature of the border regions between east and west, the coasts to the north and the mountain ranges of the south

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Dark Waters of Crime
programme.desc: Water is at the centre of the human experience. The source of life on earth, it is also a place of mystery and danger. For criminals, water is the perfect accomplice for the perfect crime: it erases, absorbs, and carries the bodies, conceals weapons and washes away evidence. For detectives, water is a crafty adversary. It never confesses, forcing the investigators to employ extraordinary measures to discover the truth. Dark Waters of Crime does not simply oppose the criminals and the investigators. It brings into play a third party, powerful, mysterious, and tenacious.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La nota que Papá Pitufo escribió avisando a los demás Pitufos para que vean un cometa está rota. Al ser sólo capaces de leer una parte, los Pitufos creen que es el fin del mundo. Todos planean cómo será su último día, hasta que papá Pitufo regresa y clarifica el lío.

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: Ahora Los Pitufeas Y Ahora No
programme.desc: Los troles subterráneos capturan a los Pitufos para que sean sus esclavos. Papá Pitufo ingeniosamente los libera y luego destruye la bola de cristal mágica que les concede el poder sobre los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En un esfuerzo por conseguir que Papá Pitufo tenga algo de tranquilidad, Pitufo Filósofo usa uno de los hechizos de Papá Pitufo para crear una barrera de sonido mágica alrededor de la aldea. Papá Pitufo no es capaz de deshacer el hechizo y envía a los Pitufitos, que han quedado atrapados fuera de la aldea, a un hacedor de ruidos. Bebé Pitufo se lleva una botella de ruido de casa del hacedor de ruidos, y así consiguen romper la barrera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No todos los días se encuentra uno con una flor parlante. Y, en especial, con un personaje como Petaluma, una planta bulbosa algo arrogante con la que Pitufina se encuentra en el bosque. Por supuesto, Pitufina se muestra encantada y lleva a Petaluma con ella a la Aldea Pitufa… desencadenando un proceso que pondrá en peligro a todos los Pitufos. Parece que las flores están hechas para contemplarlas y no para escucharlas.

programme.title: Llamen Al Doctor Pitufo
programme.desc: Tal como su propio nombre indica, Pitufo Aficionado es incapaz de concentrarse en una actividad concreta. Pasa de una cosa a otra con tremenda facilidad y nunca termina lo que empieza. Pero, de repente, descubre que le apasiona la profesión médica. Pitufo Aficionado quiere convertirse en doctor y todos los Pitufos, con Papá Pitufo a la cabeza, van a ayudarle a cumplir su deseo.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una aventura dramática y conmovedora… Pitufina y su mascota Re chillido. La pequeña Pitufina está inundada en lágrimas. ¿Podrán los demás pitufos consolarla?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Puro Trabajo Y Nada De Diversión
programme.desc: Los Pitufos malinterpretan las órdenes de Papá Pitufo de dedicar un día de trabajo a los Pitufitos. En lugar de tomarse el día libre, trabajan más que nunca y se convierten en autómatas. La única cura para esta enfermedad es hacer que no piensen en el trabajo, algo que finalmente logran cuando tienen que rescatar a los Pitufitos de las arpías del agua.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Las Crisis Del Fango
programme.desc: El Rey Verrugoso entra en pánico porque la cosecha de fango está siendo un fracaso. Decide capturar a Pitufo Labrador, el mayor experto en agricultura del mundo, para resolver su problema. Pitufo Labrador instala un sistema de riego y salva la cosecha. Después, escapa en una burbuja y regresa con los demás Pitufos.

programme.title: El Pitufo De Troya
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha ideado un nuevo plan para capturar a los Pitufos: ha construido una estatua gigante con la forma de Papá Pitufo. Espera que, al verla, los Pitufos lleven la estatua a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Madre mía! A Sasita se le ha caído un diente. Papá Pitufo le explica que, si coloca el diente bajo la almohada, encontrará un obsequio del hada de los dientes al día siguiente. Sin embargo, a la mañana siguiente no hay ningún regalo debajo de la almohada. El hada de los dientes no ha acudido. Resulta que está atrapada en una de las trampas de Gargamel. Y ahora, el malvado mago está tramando un terrible plan.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El rey Symphonium envía a su pelícano Satchelmouth para capturar a la orquesta de Pitufo Filósofo y llevar a todos hasta su isla. Pitufo Soñador se pone al timón de un barco y se hace a la mar para rescatarlos. Cuando Pitufo Soñador se marea, Pitufo Filósofo toma el mando y encabeza el equipo de rescate que libera a los Pitufos capturados.

programme.title: La Aguja Mágica De Pitufo Sastre
programme.desc: Pitufo Sastre tiene que crear un conjunto para cada Pitufo antes del desfile de moda de otoño. Pitufo Filósofo quiere ayudarle y, usando el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo, conjura una aguja mágica que cose diez veces más rápido que un sastre… ¿Pero es eso algo realmente bueno?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El chico del bosque y Laconia, la elfa muda y sorda, preguntan a Papá Pitufo que celebre su boda. Mientras los Pitufos preparan la fiesta bajo las órdenes de Pitufina, Gargamel hace acto de presencia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Tontín, al querer ser el más popular, roba uno de los hechizos de Gargamel, pero no lo usa bien y acaba convirtiéndose en un dragón. Ahora tendrán que juntarse todos los Pitufos junto con Papá Pitufo para colarse en el castillo de Gargamel y encontrar el antídoto que hará que Pitufo Tontín vuelva a su forma normal.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: El Pitufo Vanidoso
programme.desc: El espejo mágico de Gargamel deja atrapado a Pitufo Vanidoso dentro de él, así que Pitufina y Pitufo Filósofo se apresuran para rescatarlo. Una vez están dentro del mundo del espejo, provocan una gran explosión que rompe el cristal del espejo, pudiendo volver sanos y salvos al pueblo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Pitufan Nuestra Canción
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la flauta mágica de Woody para que la música que salga de ella pase de ser buena a ser mala. Gargamel captura a los Pitufos, pero Sasita les salva diciéndole a Gargamel que le ama. Este toca la flauta, pero la música se desvanece a medida que Gargamel se ve inundado de sentimientos de amor, y termina por liberar a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina promete a Madre Naturaleza que, si crea una rosa azul, nunca la cortará. Pero, cuando la rosa blanca se vuelve azul, Pitufina pasa a ser de color blanco. Lo único que Pitufina puede hacer para volver a ser azul es cortar la rosa. Corta la rosa a regañadientes, lo que devuelve la naturaleza a la normalidad, y aprende que no siempre se pueden mantener las promesas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la caja que ha encontrado Pitufo Bromista? Una capa que perteneció a Wislow, el gnomo mago. ¿Y de qué tipo de capa se trata? Pitufo Bromista descubre que es una capa de invisibilidad. Cualquiera que la lleve puesta tendrá una oportunidad fantástica para hacer bromas… e imagina el caos que puede crear Pitufo Bromista siendo invisible en la aldea. Pero si Wislow se desprendió de la capa, seguro que tenía sus motivos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En un esfuerzo por conseguir que Papá Pitufo tenga algo de tranquilidad, Pitufo Filósofo usa uno de los hechizos de Papá Pitufo para crear una barrera de sonido mágica alrededor de la aldea. Papá Pitufo no es capaz de deshacer el hechizo y envía a los Pitufitos, que han quedado atrapados fuera de la aldea, a un hacedor de ruidos. Bebé Pitufo se lleva una botella de ruido de casa del hacedor de ruidos, y así consiguen romper la barrera.

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Ómnibus regala a los Pitufos un perro al que llaman Puppy. A este animal juguetón y de tamaño normal le gusta su nuevo hogar, pero Baltasar lo captura, creyendo que los secretos mágicos de los Pitufos están escondidos en el collar de Puppy. Los Pitufos rescatan al perro y lo único que Bebé Pitufo encuentra en el medallón del collar es música.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel consigue transformar una colcha en una alfombra voladora, lo que hace inevitable que se produzcan accidentes. El resultado de uno de esos accidentes es que un trozo de la tela voladora acaba utilizándose como pañal para Bebé Pitufo, con resultados realmente sorprendentes…

programme.title: Los Amigos De Soñador
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Soñador decide visitar a sus amigos, los Tufos, Papá Pitufo crea una poción para transformar a los Pitufos en criaturas de aspecto alienígena. Sin embargo, los efectos de la poción desaparecen demasiado pronto y Pitufo Soñador tiene que enfrentarse a la realidad de que los Tufos no existen. Está triste hasta que llega un alienígena de verdad para devolver a Pitufo Soñador su carta, ya que la recibió por error.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un monstruo del pantano secuestra a Bebé Pitufo como regalo para una bruja. La bruja, que cree que nadie la ama, se sorprende cuando Bebé Pitufo le demuestra afecto. Cuando Papá Pitufo acude a rescatar a Bebé Pitufo, consigue que la bruja entienda que el leal monstruo del pantano siempre la ha amado.

programme.title: Ya Pitufaron Al Cachorro
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan absortos con el nuevo juguete de Pitufo Carpintero que se olvidan de dar de comer a Puppy. Gargamel atrae a Puppy hacia una jaula con comida y le mantiene cautivo para pedir un rescate: los secretos mágicos de los Pitufos. Los Pitufitos distraen a Gargamel con el juguete durante el tiempo necesario para rescatar a Puppy, y prometen no volver a dejarlo desatendido.

programme.title: Puro Trabajo Y Nada De Diversión
programme.desc: Los Pitufos malinterpretan las órdenes de Papá Pitufo de dedicar un día de trabajo a los Pitufitos. En lugar de tomarse el día libre, trabajan más que nunca y se convierten en autómatas. La única cura para esta enfermedad es hacer que no piensen en el trabajo, algo que finalmente logran cuando tienen que rescatar a los Pitufitos de las arpías del agua.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El río Pitufo ha desaparecido: alguien lo ha congelado cerca de su nacimiento. Los Pitufos viajan hasta el país de la Emperatriz Esmeralda para descubrir cuál es el problema y se encuentran con el Oso Parches y los Piratas de Hierro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: El Dulce Diente De Pitufina
programme.desc: Una vez al año, Pitufo Goloso prepara un lote especial de caramelos de pitufrutas. Cada Pitufo recibe provisiones para un año entero del dulce más pitufantástico de todo el mundo. Pero ¿puede un Pitufo conseguir que sus provisiones le duren todo el año? ¿Lo conseguirá Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1545, Pope Paul III took Parma and Piacenza away from the papal territories to create a new duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese and free them from the influence of the Lombard Gonzaga family. The first duke and his heirs Alessandro and Ranuccio welcomed some Correggio's to work in the baptistery of the cathedral and some Parmigianino's paintings in the monastery of San Paolo.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Lake Tahoe, California and check out the Sierra Boat Company.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Virginia is the birthplace of wine in America! We talk with the innovators and pioneers who have helped establish this wine region as one of the most exciting in the county. We also visit a goat cheese farm, one of JFKs favorite hangout towns, Middleburg, and discuss Thomas Jefferson's effect on the region. From juicy Cabernet Franc to floral Viognier, funky Petit Manseng, and powerful Petit Verdot, Virginia has a wine for everyone.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Southern Rhone may be the most beautiful wine region in France! Stunning landscapes, quaint villages, ancient geography, and tons of Côtes du Rhône vineyards, all winding along the Rhône River in the South of France. The winemakers have tremendous respect for the land and work hard to preserve its legacy. Join Vince and his friend and local Frenchman, Sarkis, on a road trip through this wonderful wine region while learning about the fresh & fun red, rosé, and white wines of Southern Rhône!

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Chile is the perfect gateway to explore the rich diversity and value of South American wines! From vibrant Cabernet Sauvignon to velvety Carménère, the wines produced in Chile mirror its extraordinary geography—cool Pacific breezes and the towering Andes mountains. Add to that the warmth of welcoming locals, breathtaking landscapes, and delectable cuisine, and you've crafted the perfect recipe for an unforgettable wine adventure.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Languedoc-Roussillon is France's largest wine region and has more organic vineyard land than anywhere else on the planet! Its sheer size means it can produce an enormous variety of wine styles, from sparkling wines to rich whites, spicy reds, and even luscious dessert wines. Biodynamic winemaking pioneer Gérard Bertrand takes center stage, highlighting why caring for the planet and producing incredible wines aren't mutually exclusive.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Lebanon is remarkable! It's one of the world’s oldest wine regions, full of resilient people, ancient winegrowing heritage, and fresh cuisine that rivals any gastronomy on the planet! Besides having a robust winegrowing history, the country’s Mediterranean climate and mountainous terrain produce a host of delicious, fresh wines, from crisp indigenous white grapes like Obeidy and Merwah to rich, spicy blends of Cabernet and Syrah. Plus, the food is some of the most flavorful in the world, and the people have a zest for life.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Virginia is the birthplace of wine in America! We talk with the innovators and pioneers who have helped establish this wine region as one of the most exciting in the county. We also visit a goat cheese farm, one of JFKs favorite hangout towns, Middleburg, and discuss Thomas Jefferson's effect on the region. From juicy Cabernet Franc to floral Viognier, funky Petit Manseng, and powerful Petit Verdot, Virginia has a wine for everyone.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick head up to Cooperstown, NY and dine at an exotic greenhouse that has a food truck as its kitchen. Join them as they visit a distillery and brewery based around the game of baseball. Then check into a world class hotel and visit a farmers museum that takes them back in time.

programme.title: Great Destinations Africa

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E01 - Part One
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we explore the USS Arizona and the marine environment which formed around it. Later, we journey into the underwater world of Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E02 - Part Two
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we dive into the cave systems of Death Valley National Park, journey to Montezuma Well, search for shipwrecks in Buck Island, and explore Lake Mead.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Iceland: home to volcanic lakes and hot springs and mono-chromatic vistas. And then to Laos in South East Asia with its lush jungles, underground caves and water buffalo along the Mekong River.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration
programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: Surf Splendor

programme.desc: Mark Mathews, big-wave champ and speaker, confronts fear to inspire anyone in tough fights.

programme.title: LENA
programme.desc: L E N A documents the purpose and persistent journey of the first German female big wave surfer.

programme.title: The Essence of Surfing
programme.desc: The Essence of Surfing is a riveting surf documentary that gets to the heart of why surfing is the greatest sport in the world. Featuring surfers of all kinds, from the neighborhood grom to some of the greatest surfers to ever live, The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives.
