programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Largemouth Bass Fishing at Lake El Salto, Part Two
programme.desc: If you're a bass fisherman, you have most likely heard of the world-class Lake El Salto. Dave Brown from Okuma Fishing Tackle and professional bass fisherman Todd Kline rally up with Savage Gear and test out their rat and duck lures on this Stoked On Fishing adventure.

programme.title: Catching Bass | All About Timing
programme.desc: Being in the Right Place at the Right Time for Huge Bass

programme.title: FishON! | Northern Adventures: Mid-Summer Walleye Quest with Cameron Racine from Mercury Canada
programme.desc: Join us on an exhilarating journey deep into the heart of Northern Ontario as we tackle mid-summer walleye fishing like never before! Guided by the rising sun, we gear up with our Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake for a day filled with fishing action and good times. Joining the adventure is Mercury Canada Marketing Manager Cameron Racine, adding expertise and excitement to this unforgettable outing. Don't miss the fun, the fish, and the breathtaking scenery!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. This trip was absolutely nuts, with the best Blue Fin Tuna fishing we have seen in Sothern California all year.

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Building Bladed Jigs
programme.desc: Jim explains how to build one of the most effective baits for bass.

programme.title: Operation Fishing Freedom - Army Veteran Erik Hill
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Sergeant and former Alaska State Trooper, Erik Hill hits the Wisconsin waters to lure more than just bass to the surface. He shares the story of his life, his service, and his struggles since returning from war.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Stoked on Coiba National Park, Panama: Part Four
programme.desc: A few years back, we rallied up with my buddy Chris Atkins who owns and operates Central America fishing. He told me, Shea, you have to do a Stoked On Fishing Charters Panama trip and fish at Coiba National Park. It's the largest island in Central America, next to the world-famous Hannibal Bank. Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Easy Fishing Tactics
programme.desc: Fishing can be very high-tech, but on the other end of the spectrum, it can actually be very simple. Today we're going to show you some presentations and tactics to put fish in the boat....easily!

programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

programme.desc: Brent Chapmans Pro vs Joe-Aligator Lake

programme.title: Flipping and Pitching Lake Perris, CA, Part Two
programme.desc: Shea's heads spend another two days fishing in Lake Perris, but this time he's not alone. Fishing with his brother and good friend, they get into Bluegill, Bass, and some big Carp.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.desc: In this action-packed adventure, we push deep into the remote forests west of Timmins with an incredible young angler, Cohen. programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman’s daughter, the second one married the merchant’s daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren’t they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it’s not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn’t you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn’t like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Olegario le reclama a Pastor lo el pan de jamón. Pastor piensa que le interesa Ana y en ese momento se presenta Clarisa. Finita está tomando el papelito para el amigo secreto y llega Gisela y comienza a pelearse con Briggite y viceversa. Graciela está como loca y se quiere ir de la oficina de Junior. Freddy la aconseja para que se quede. Atanasio le cuenta a Armando lo de Graciela Armando piensa y se lo dice a Atanasio que es como la película Atracción Fatal.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina monta en cólera al enterarse que Gerson está sembrando guayabas porque ella sabe que lo hace para ayudarle en el negocio a Yureima. Por otro lado, Pascua está feliz de que fue aprobado el crédito para su negocio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska publica una foto comprometedora para separar a Ricardo y Manuela, desatando conflictos familiares y laborales. Ricardo, furioso, se enfrenta a su madre y amenaza con irse de casa. Mientras tanto, Elizabeth y Moisés luchan con sus sentimientos prohibidos pese a las súplicas de Celia. Graciela cae en depresión y Marcelo teme perder a sus hijos. Finalmente, Misael le muestra el periódico a Manuela, quien queda profundamente dolida al ver la imagen de Ricardo y Katiuska.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo exige a Rosalía someterse al examen médico que confirma embarazo de un solo mes, posterior a la boda. Eustoquio amenaza a Erasto con matarlo si lo toca y éste lo expulsa de la casa. Consuelo, Leticia y Salvador salen a buscar a Isaías en bares. Mildred enfrenta a Junior y Rosa sobre el supuesto embarazo. Robert llega con sus padres a la boda con Andreína. Carmen Rosa visita a Arminda exigiéndole respuestas pero ésta le ofrece dinero para callar. Rosa, caminando por la calle, oye un grito y encuentra a Isaías gravemente herido al borde del andamio.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina escucha a Julio contarle a Fernando que él fue quien metió preso a Leo. Su tía lo confronta violentamente y ante la amenaza de exponerlo frente a su padre, Julio le miente diciendo que lo dijo para impresionar a Fernando. Tony visita a Leo en la cárcel. Leo se queja amargamente de la falta de atención de su familia. María Lucía recibe el reto de su abuela por la carta de Leo hallada en la caja de música. Luego, junto a Sandra, reconstruyen la carta, la cual muestra el amor de Leo por ella. Leonardo, Irene y Maribel están en un hotel fuera de la ciudad para arreglar la situación de las fórmulas de Galeano. Entre los ex cónyuges, la tensión es creciente.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Con la prueba de ADN en sus manos, de que no es hermano de Sol, Alejandro habla con está y le dice que le tiene una gran sorpresa. Pero luego es secuestrado por un par de maleantes que responden a Heriberto. Heriberto chantajea a Anselmo y logra salir de la cárcel, ve a Alejandro y le dice que hoy Sol será su mujer. Reina escapa de su custodia policial en el hospital. Giselle y Cristo José están de acuerdo en decirle la verdad Giselita de que tiene dos madres.

Su tía lo confronta violentamente y ante la amenaza de exponerlo frente a su padre, Julio le miente diciendo que lo dijo para impresionar a Fernando. Tony visita a Leo en la cárcel. Leo se queja amargamente de la falta de atención de su familia. María Lucía recibe el reto de su abuela por la carta de Leo hallada en la caja de música. Luego, junto a Sandra, reconstruyen la carta, la cual muestra el amor de Leo por ella. Leonardo, Irene y Maribel están en un hotel fuera de la ciudad para arreglar la situación de las fórmulas de Galeano. Entre los ex cónyuges, la tensión es creciente.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Con la prueba de ADN en sus manos, de que no es hermano de Sol, Alejandro habla con está y le dice que le tiene una gran sorpresa. Pero luego es secuestrado por un par de maleantes que responden a Heriberto. Heriberto chantajea a Anselmo y logra salir de la cárcel, ve a Alejandro y le dice que hoy Sol será su mujer. Reina escapa de su custodia policial en el hospital. Giselle y Cristo José están de acuerdo en decirle la verdad Giselita de que tiene dos madres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Olegario le reclama a Pastor lo el pan de jamón. Pastor piensa que le interesa Ana y en ese momento se presenta Clarisa. Finita está tomando el papelito para el amigo secreto y llega Gisela y comienza a pelearse con Briggite y viceversa. Graciela está como loca y se quiere ir de la oficina de Junior. Freddy la aconseja para que se quede. Atanasio le cuenta a Armando lo de Graciela Armando piensa y se lo dice a Atanasio que es como la película Atracción Fatal.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina monta en cólera al enterarse que Gerson está sembrando guayabas porque ella sabe que lo hace para ayudarle en el negocio a Yureima. Por otro lado, Pascua está feliz de que fue aprobado el crédito para su negocio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska publica una foto comprometedora para separar a Ricardo y Manuela, desatando conflictos familiares y laborales. Ricardo, furioso, se enfrenta a su madre y amenaza con irse de casa. Mientras tanto, Elizabeth y Moisés luchan con sus sentimientos prohibidos pese a las súplicas de Celia. Graciela cae en depresión y Marcelo teme perder a sus hijos. Finalmente, Misael le muestra el periódico a Manuela, quien queda profundamente dolida al ver la imagen de Ricardo y Katiuska.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo exige a Rosalía someterse al examen médico que confirma embarazo de un solo mes, posterior a la boda. Eustoquio amenaza a Erasto con matarlo si lo toca y éste lo expulsa de la casa. Consuelo, Leticia y Salvador salen a buscar a Isaías en bares. Mildred enfrenta a Junior y Rosa sobre el supuesto embarazo. Robert llega con sus padres a la boda con Andreína. Carmen Rosa visita a Arminda exigiéndole respuestas pero ésta le ofrece dinero para callar. Rosa, caminando por la calle, oye un grito y encuentra a Isaías gravemente herido al borde del andamio.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo está detenido por la denuncia que Alejandra hizo porque él entró en su departamento. Felipe está llevando adelante el caso y le advirtió a Altamirano que será destituida de su cargo. Jimena se entera que Carlos Ernesto tiene un documento en Tribunales que puede reabrir el caso de Miguel, lo cual la enfurece e intenta evitarlo, pero Carlos Ernesto está convencido en continuar con el caso para limpiar el nombre de Virginia y encontrar al verdadero asesino. María Lucía y Oriana siguen confundidas por Leo, piensan que está jugando con las dos. Galeano piensa que Mateo es hijo de Leonardo y que él e Irene están juntos. Esto siembra la duda en Leonardo, quien más tarde indaga a Irene para que le responda si Mateo es o no hijo suyo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto mantiene encerrado a Alejandro para evitar que se interponga en sus planes de hacer el amor con Sol. El secuaz de Heriberto sorprende a Reina merodeando por el refugio. Entonces, Heriberto y ella acuerdan ayudarse mutuamente, pero cada uno tiene agendas diferentes. Sol comienza a desesperarse por la desaparición de Alejandro. Llama al jefe Tavares y éste le sugiere que esperen hasta el día siguiente. El jefe sabe la verdad pero quiere que Alejandro se lo diga
